view.en: Side-view 2D: a cloaked swordsman stands in a closed room facing a boss. Your health points and energy are shown at the top or corner of the screen, and the boss's health bar at the top

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose when your health points reach zero; each fight has a time limit and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate by itself; you must build energy by hitting the boss and then channel healing

keys.en: hold to slash upward; used with the slash button
hold in the air and slash to strike downward; hitting the boss or a bounceable attack bounces you up (pogo)
jump: hold for height, release to cut it short
dash: once per air time, about 0.6 s cooldown
hold on the ground to heal: standing still for about 1.1 s spends 33 energy for 1 health

notes.en: Each hit on the boss stores 11 energy; healing needs 33 and takes about 1.1 s holding K on the ground; moving, leaving the ground or being hit cancels it
Side slashes alternate between two swings, resetting after 0.5 s; slashes have about a 0.41 s cooldown
Early presses are buffered: jump about 0.04 s, slash about 0.1 s, dash about 0.2 s
A downward hit on the boss or a bounceable attack bounces you up and refreshes the air dash (not the dash cooldown), so you can chain pogos
You cannot dash during the first 0.1 s of a slash
Each boss's stagger (collapsing when pressured) is the time to deal concentrated damage

options.left_tap: tap left once at sub-step 1 (to turn around)
options.right_tap: tap right once at sub-step 1 (to turn around)

options.hold: hold jump for the whole packet (high jump; only starts if jump was not held at the end of the previous packet)
options.press2_hold: press jump at sub-step 2 and hold (use after holding jump in the previous packet)

options.down_1: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 1 (air only)
options.down_2: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 2 (air only)
options.down_3: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 3 (air only)
options.down_4: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 4 (air only)
options.down_5: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 5 (air only)
options.down_6: downward slash, repeated presses from sub-step 6 (air only)
options.dash_mid: dash at sub-step 4 (pair with a jump for an air dash)
options.heal: channel healing, held the whole packet (stand still on the ground)

summary.en: A closed room duel against a blade-wielding berserker who dashes, leaps, and pours orange ooze from the walls and roof.

tell.en: Steps back and crouches with the blade drawn back, then crosses most of the room in one dash

counter.en: Jump over it or stay clear; the 0.25 s recovery after the dash is your opening

tell.en: Jumps and hangs in the air with the blade drawn, then dashes at head height

effect.en: Dashes sideways at head height; contact hurts

counter.en: Stay low, out of its height line; it falls after the dash with about 0.25 s of recovery to punish

tell.en: Crouches, then jumps to a random point in the room

counter.en: Move off the landing point; it has about 0.17 s of landing recovery

tell.en: Jumps over you, hangs with the blade pointing down, then plunges and splashes four blobs along the floor

effect.en: The plunge and the blobs both hurt

counter.en: Leave the landing spot and jump the blobs; the roughly 0.9 s of recovery after landing is your opening

tell.en: Raises the blade and flails it over its head while you are above it

effect.en: Hits you when you are above it

counter.en: Do not hover above it; about 0.17 s of recovery afterwards

tell.en: Hops backwards away from a close player

effect.en: Not an attack, but often leads into one

counter.en: Do not chase; anticipate the follow-up

tell.en: Jumps to the middle and shakes; orange blobs pour from both walls and the roof for about four seconds

counter.en: Weave through gaps between blobs; do not stand under falling ones

tell.en: Once its health bar is below about four fifths, balloons drift in every 4-5 seconds and chase you

counter.en: One strike pops them; do not let them pile up

phases.en: Below about four fifths health, chasing balloons are added.

summary.en: A heavily armoured mace soldier hunts you on flat ground while barrels drop from the roof.

tell.en: Crouches with the mace on its shoulder, then leaps toward you (half of the leaps go to a random spot)

counter.en: Step away from the landing; about 0.5 s of landing recovery is your opening

tell.en: Leaps with the mace raised and brings it down in front of it on landing

effect.en: Slams in front of it; the area hurts

counter.en: Stay out of the front of its landing; about 0.25 s of recoil after the slam

tell.en: Jumps back, then winds the mace far behind its head for over a second

effect.en: The smash sends a shockwave along the floor

counter.en: Jump the shockwave; about 0.42 s of recovery after the smash

tell.en: When you are far away it runs at you and follows up with the leaping slam

effect.en: Both the run and the slam hurt

counter.en: Do not stay far away; jump the run, then dodge the slam

tell.en: After the exposed rider is beaten back into the armour, it jumps to the middle and slams left and right

effect.en: Slams the floor on both sides in succession

counter.en: Move and jump in the gaps between slams

tell.en: Dust trickles from the roof where a barrel is about to drop

effect.en: The barrel hurts if it lands on you

counter.en: Leave the spot as soon as dust appears

phases.en: When the armour breaks an exposed rider appears; beating it back into the armour triggers the rage slams.

summary.en: A glowing four-winged boss fills the arena with light orbs, sword patterns and beams; later the floor turns into an abyss.

tell.en: Her core flares and up to three orbs of light peel away from her, then home in

counter.en: Lead them into the floor or a wall so they burst

tell.en: Twelve swords stand in a ring around her, points outward

effect.en: Swords shoot outward and deal 2 damage

counter.en: Stand between two swords' lines; farther away is safer

tell.en: Rows of swords hang along the ceiling, points down, with two wide gaps

counter.en: Stand under a gap; she teleports half-way through

tell.en: A column of swords forms along one side wall, with one gap open at the floor or at full-jump height

effect.en: The wall sweeps across, dealing 2 damage

counter.en: Stand in a floor gap; for a high gap, jump as it arrives

tell.en: Thin lines of light spread from her in eight directions

counter.en: Stand between two lines; the next burst turns half a step

tell.en: Light gathers along one side wall

effect.en: A wall of light sweeps the arena for 2 damage

counter.en: Run to the far end; it fades just short of the far wall

tell.en: One half of the floor glows, then spikes rise there

counter.en: Stand on the other half

tell.en: After the stagger the floor darkens into an abyss between four pale footholds

effect.en: Falling into the abyss deals 1 damage

counter.en: Stay on the footholds and jump the gaps

tell.en: A thin line of light drops where you stand

counter.en: Step aside; after the third beam she sinks within reach and one strike ends her

tell.en: She dissolves into light and re-forms elsewhere

counter.en: Re-locate her; do not chase blindly

tell.en: She screams and the arena changes

effect.en: No direct damage, but marks a phase change

counter.en: Use the moment to reposition for the new arena

phases.en: After a stagger the arena becomes an abyss with footholds; after the last big beams she sinks low and can be finished with one strike.

summary.en: An agile green-robed fighter attacks with a spear, dashes and whirlwinds; her pause after throwing gives you an opening.

tell.en: Crouches low facing you with the spear drawn back

counter.en: Jump over her and pogo; she slides to a stop for about 0.33 s

tell.en: Jumps, then freezes mid-air and aims at your feet; the aim is locked when the freeze starts

counter.en: Move once she freezes; the 0.5 s hard landing is your opening

tell.en: Rears back with the spear; always thrown horizontally

effect.en: The spear flies horizontally and hurts on its way out and back

counter.en: Jump it; she stands still until the spear returns (about 1 s), so attack her then

tell.en: Plants her feet while a whirlwind gathers around her

effect.en: The whirlwind hurts when it bursts

counter.en: Keep away from her; about 0.17 s of recovery after the burst

tell.en: Stalls on the way down while a whirlwind gathers

effect.en: The whirlwind hurts when it bursts

counter.en: Go around; do not stand right below her

tell.en: Short crouch, then a fast back-step when you are close

counter.en: Do not chase; wait for her next move

phases.en: While she throws she stands still, and stagger does not accumulate during that time.

summary.en: A pale swordsman with a split chest and a huge move set: it teleports, counters and sprays orange blobs, and changes forms as its health drops.

tell.en: Plants the blade behind its shoulder, then three wide swings stepping forward; the 2nd and 3rd also reach behind it

effect.en: All three swings have a wide reach

counter.en: Back off or jump; about 0.33 s of recovery after the third swing

tell.en: Crouches with the blade pointed forward, then lunges along the ground

counter.en: Jump it; it slides to a stop for about 0.45 s, your opening

tell.en: Raises the blade; when it shines, a frontal hit is blocked and answered by a fast sliding riposte

effect.en: Hitting the front gets you riposted

counter.en: Do not hit the front while the blade shines; it lowers the guard after about 0.75 s

tell.en: Hops backwards away from a close player, often straight into another attack

counter.en: Anticipate the follow-up on landing

tell.en: Crouches and leaps across the room

counter.en: Dodge the landing; about 0.33 s of landing recovery

tell.en: Fades out and reappears at a distance (or high above you) ready to attack

counter.en: Watch where it appears and prepare to dodge

tell.en: Leaps (or teleports) above you, hangs with the blade pointing down, then slams into the floor

effect.en: The slam hurts and the pillars burst

counter.en: Leave the spot; it stands for about 1.1 s after landing while the pillars burst

tell.en: Orange glows spread across the floor from where it landed; columns of fire shoot up from every glow at once

counter.en: Stand in the gaps between glows, or jump

tell.en: Opens its cloak and sprays 9-10 blobs in a sweeping arc over about three quarters of the room

counter.en: Find gaps or the uncovered side; about 0.36 s of recovery

tell.en: Rises to the middle of the room and blobs burst out of its chest in arcs to both sides and downward

counter.en: Slip between the arcs; it can be hit from below the whole time, including its fall

tell.en: Jerked up like a puppet, it floats after you and slams down 2-5 times

counter.en: Sidestep each slam; after the last it collapses for about 1.6 s

tell.en: Turns the blade on itself and stabs its own chest; hits only deal 1 meanwhile, then it collapses

counter.en: Save your damage for the full stagger after the collapse (about 2.25 s)

tell.en: Staggers toward you, raises the blade for one swing and falls to its knees

counter.en: Dodge the swing; it kneels for a full stagger of about 2.25 s

tell.en: Screams at each phase change

effect.en: No direct damage; marks a phase change

counter.en: Use it to reposition

phases.en: As health drops it changes form and uses moves such as self stab and weak slash, each phase change marked by a roar.

summary.en: Three lance fighters take turns attacking with dashes, plunges, boomerang blades and two-person combos.

tell.en: Appears crouched at one end of the floor with the lance drawn back, then crosses the whole floor

effect.en: The whole floor is the damage path

counter.en: Jump it; it stands at the far end for about 0.63 s, your opening

tell.en: Appears high above you pointing the lance down, then drops straight onto the floor

counter.en: Move sideways when it appears; about 0.67 s of landing pose

tell.en: Clings to a side wall high (blade will sink) or low (blade will rise) and winds up a throw

counter.en: Anticipate the rise or sink; she hangs on the wall about 1.2 s after the throw, so strike then

tell.en: A spinning blade crosses the room, slows, and flies back to the thrower

counter.en: Jump it and watch for the return

tell.en: When you hug a wall, a fighter appears on the far wall at your height and throws

effect.en: Throws a blade at your height

counter.en: Do not hug the wall; move up or down off the line

tell.en: Two fighters at once: dash + plunge combos, a pincer dash from both ends, or blades from both walls

effect.en: Attacks from two directions at once

counter.en: Read both positions first; jump in the gap between the two attacks

phases.en: As health drops, the fight goes from one fighter at a time to two at once, and finally only one remains.
